nodes.title: Final prompt actually sent to Krea
Adjustable inputs — automatic edit and skin-reference masks
widgets_values:
# Adjustable inputs

| Input | What it controls | Why adjust it |
|---|---|---|
| **Source image** | Photograph supplied to both CLIPSeg passes, the Qwen prompt writer and Krea | Load once per edit; no manual edit or skin-sample masks are required. |
| **Edit CLIPSeg text** | Garment/object replaced by Krea | Use a short noun such as `shirt`, `sleeves`, `crop top` or `dress`. |
| **Edit threshold** | Tightness of the replacement mask | Lower below `0.50` when garment edges are missing; raise it when nearby skin, hair or clothing is selected. |
| **Skin-reference CLIPSeg text** | Source pixels treated as known-good skin | Start with `human skin`. Try `face and arms skin` only if the simple prompt selects unrelated objects. |
| **Skin-reference threshold** | Confidence required for automatic skin samples | Start at `0.60`; raise it when skin-coloured fabric/background appears, or lower it when too little real skin remains. |
| **Two selection previews** | Shows the edit mask and detected source skin | Visible pixels are selected; grey pixels are excluded. Check both before judging Krea or colour matching. |
| **Edit instruction / manual prompt** | Requested change when automatic prompting is on; complete Krea prompt when it is off | With automation on, keep this concise, for example `replace the long-sleeved shirt with a sleeveless black crop top`. |
| **AutoPromptControl** | Lets Qwen3-VL 4B inspect the source and write the complete final prompt | Leave on for normal use. Turn off to send your text directly to Krea for troubleshooting or precise manual prompting. |
| **EditDenoise** | Strength of Krea's redraw | Raise it for stubborn garment seams; lower it when anatomy, pose or nearby details drift. |
| **MaskGrowControl** | Expansion of Krea's sampling region | Raise it when cuffs/hems survive; lower it when nearby protected content changes. |
| **SeedControl** | Generated variation | Hold fixed while comparing masks/settings; change it for a different reconstruction. |
| **PostSkinColorMatchControl** | Enables automatic mask-aware skin matching | Enable when the selected garment becomes exposed skin; disable when selected areas should remain fabric. |
| **PostSkinColorStrength** | Overall colour correction, `0–1` | Start at `0.40–0.50`; lower it if skin becomes flat/dark, and raise it if generated skin still differs. |

Inside the Krea subgraph, **Qwen image-aware final prompt writer** receives the original source image plus the edit instruction. Its preview/output is the exact prompt sent to Krea. **Automatic masked LAB skin colour match** erodes skin-mask edges by 12 px, excludes the garment mask from its reference pixels, rejects LAB colour outliers, limits luminance transfer to 0.35, and feathers the correction by 12 px.

widgets_values:
Write one cohesive image-generation prompt for the final photograph after the requested change. Use the supplied photograph as the visual reference for the person's identity, face, hair, expression, pose, proportions, camera viewpoint, framing, setting, lighting, shadows, colour, and depth of field. Incorporate the requested change naturally and describe the resulting appearance, while carrying forward the other visible details. Where body regions become visible, keep their appearance natural and consistent with the visible skin and scene lighting. Describe the final photograph directly. Output only the prompt paragraph.

Requested change:

A high-resolution, surreal digital illustration showing a human hand holding a martini glass. The image is overlaid with whimsical, expressive ink-style doodles, including a cartoon figure inside the glass, a drawn citrus wedge on the rim, and various abstract sketches and faces surrounding the glass against a clean, white background. The style seamlessly blends a realistic, lit photograph with loose, hand-drawn marker artistry, creating a playful and artistic juxtaposition.
